verdict.rationale: Multiple first-party sources confirm Jan runs local models (HuggingFace/GGUF) while also connecting to cloud providers like OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral, Groq, MiniMax within the same app, explicitly marketed as 'switch freely between local and frontier models.' Community mention corroborates real-world usage as an alternative to cloud-only tools like OpenWebUI. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of simultaneous multi-provider switching in a single session.
